value.answer: Right now the lowest 5-year fixed rates in Canada are around 4.34%, at lenders like Frank Mortgage and some credit unions, as of this week. Big banks are higher, roughly 5.1% to 5.2%, and rates are creeping up again this month. Your exact rate depends on your down payment and lender, so if you tell me whether you're under 20% down, I can narrow it down.
